documents-about-default.cypher:
MATCH (:Concept {value:'your search'})-[r:RELEVANT_TO]->(d:Document)
RETURN d.title AS title, r.score AS score, r.snippet AS snippet, r.mode AS mode
ORDER BY r.score DESC LIMIT 10

documents-mentions-tag-dates.cypher:
MATCH (:Concept {value:'O\'Brien'})-[r:RELEVANT_TO {via:'keyword'}]->(d:Document)
WHERE 'legal' IN d.tags
  AND d.ingestionTimestamp >= '2026-01-01'
  AND d.ingestionTimestamp < '2026-06-01'
  AND r.score >= 0.4
RETURN d.title AS title, r.score AS score, r.snippet AS snippet, r.matchedTerms AS matched
ORDER BY r.score DESC LIMIT 5

documents-judged-ai.cypher:
// judged retrieval: several LLM calls per anchor — an explicit choice, never a default
MATCH (:Concept {value:'renewal'})-[r:RELEVANT_TO {via:'agentic-rag', intent:'is it a risk?', ai:{hint:'be strict', model:'gpt-4o', temperature:0.2, confidence:0.8, fresh:true}}]->(d:Document)
RETURN d.title AS title, r.score AS score, r.snippet AS evidence, r.intent AS intent
ORDER BY r.score DESC LIMIT 3

files-mentions.cypher:
MATCH (:Concept {value:'renewal'})-[r:RELEVANT_TO {via:'keyword'}]->(f:File)
RETURN f.name AS name, f.dir AS dir, f.content AS excerpt, f.modifiedAt AS modified
ORDER BY modified DESC LIMIT 10

files-judged.cypher:
// judged retrieval over file contents: several LLM calls per anchor
MATCH (:Concept {value:'an idea'})-[r:RELEVANT_TO {via:'agentic-rag'}]->(f:File)
RETURN f.name AS name, f.dir AS dir, r.score AS score, r.snippet AS evidence
ORDER BY r.score DESC LIMIT 7

threads-topic.cypher:
MATCH (:Concept {value:'the renewal'})-[r:RELEVANT_TO]->(t:RelevantEmailThread)
WHERE r.score >= 0.6
RETURN t.subject AS subject, t.snippet AS snippet, r.score AS score
ORDER BY r.score DESC LIMIT 10

threads-person-minscore.cypher:
MATCH (:Person {name:'Ada Lovelace'})-[r:RELEVANT_TO]->(t:RelevantEmailThread)
WHERE r.score >= 0.9
RETURN t.subject AS subject, t.snippet AS snippet, r.score AS score
ORDER BY r.score DESC LIMIT 2

canvas.cypher:
MATCH (d:Document)
RETURN d.title AS title, d.tags AS tags, d.uri AS uri
ORDER BY d.ingestionTimestamp DESC LIMIT 25
